lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca4Ho4Sb4O24 (reduced formula CaHoSbO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 119), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral Ca and Ho centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sb adopts a six-vertex coordination environment with mixed Ca and O neighbors. O centers show three- or four-coordinate environments involving Ca, Ho, and Sb. The resulting geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Ca and Ho octahedra and corner- and edge-sharing between Ca octahedra.
